title: Placement Corner
outcome: By the end of this course, you will be equipped with the essential skills and knowledge required to excel in job placements and interviews. You will develop a polished and professional resume, master the art of interview etiquette, and gain valuable experience through mock interviews. You will not only increase your confidence in presenting themselves to potential employers but also enhance their chances of securing their desired job opportunities.
why: The purpose of the placement preparation course is to empower you with the tools they need to succeed in the competitive job market. The course aims to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical application by focusing on three key areas: resume building, interview etiquette, and mock interviews.
